summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP on install and import
details: The package is a scoped-namespace shim (version 99.0.1) whose main entry re-exports a Proxy returning no-op functions, allowing consumer builds to resolve this name without errors. On `npm install` (postinstall hook) and on `require('@greenlake/session')` (main-module side effect), beacon.cjs issues a plain-HTTP POST to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc carrying a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version. The inflated version number, scoped name mimicking an internal namespace, Proxy no-op surface, and automatic beacon on both install and import together form a dependency-confusion exfiltration shape: any build that resolves @greenlake/session from the public registry instead of the intended private source leaks internal host identifiers and install locations to the hardcoded endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
